objectives.en: Restrict sine and cosine to make them one-one
State the domain and range of sin⁻¹ and cos⁻¹

narration.en: sin 30°, sin 150° and sin 390° are all 1/2. If we ask "which angle has sine one half?", we must agree on one answer. That agreement is the principal value.
narration.kn: sin 30°, sin 150°, sin 390° ಎಲ್ಲವೂ 1/2. "ಯಾವ ಕೋನದ ಸೈನ್ 1/2?" ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿದರೆ ಒಂದೇ ಉತ್ತರ ಬೇಕು. ಆ ಒಪ್ಪಿತ ಉತ್ತರವೇ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಬೆಲೆ.

body.en: sin is not one-one on $R$: $\sin 0 = \sin \pi = 0$. On $[-\pi/2, \pi/2]$ it is one-one and takes every value in $[-1, 1]$, so it has an inverse there: $\sin^{-1} : [-1, 1] \to [-\pi/2, \pi/2]$. This interval is the principal value branch.
body.kn: R ಮೇಲೆ sin ಏಕೈಕವಲ್ಲ. [−π/2, π/2] ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅದು ಏಕೈಕ ಮತ್ತು [−1, 1] ನ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ sin⁻¹ : [−1, 1] → [−π/2, π/2]. ಇದೇ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಬೆಲೆಯ ಶಾಖೆ.

points.en: sin⁻¹ x is an angle, not 1/sin x

narration.en: Sine is not one-one on all real numbers, so we keep only the piece from minus pi by 2 to pi by 2. There it has an inverse, sin inverse, with domain minus one to one.
narration.kn: R ಮೇಲೆ sin ಏಕೈಕವಲ್ಲ. [−π/2, π/2] ನಲ್ಲಿ ಅದು ಏಕೈಕ ಮತ್ತು [−1, 1] ನ ಎಲ್ಲ ಬೆಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಪಡೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ sin⁻¹ : [−1, 1] → [−π/2, π/2]. ಇದೇ ಮುಖ್ಯ ಬೆಲೆಯ ಶಾಖೆ.

body.en: cos is one-one on $[0, \pi]$ and takes every value in $[-1, 1]$ there. So $\cos^{-1} : [-1, 1] \to [0, \pi]$. For a negative input the angle lies in $(\pi/2, \pi]$.
body.kn: cos, [0, π] ನಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕೈಕ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ cos⁻¹ : [−1, 1] → [0, π]. ಋಣ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಕೋನ (π/2, π] ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: For cosine we keep the piece from zero to pi. So cos inverse takes values from minus one to one and gives angles from zero to pi.
narration.kn: cos, [0, π] ನಲ್ಲಿ ಏಕೈಕ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ cos⁻¹ : [−1, 1] → [0, π]. ಋಣ ಬೆಲೆಗೆ ಕೋನ (π/2, π] ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುತ್ತದೆ.

caption.en: y = sin x rises steadily from −1 to 1 between x = −π/2 and x = π/2: on that piece every value is reached exactly once.

narration.en: Look at the sine curve. Between minus pi by 2 and pi by 2 it rises steadily, so each value is reached exactly once. That piece is the principal branch.
